title: Unbounded proper scalar mate equals the tensor projection
statement: For a ring map φ:A→B, a scheme morphism f:Z→W and an arbitrary J in the unbounded derived category on Z, the restricted scalar mate followed by the direct-image restriction comparison equals the canonical scalar/tensor identification, the proper projection map, and the induced tensor/pullback comparison. No bounded-below witness is required.

source.place: Proposition 2.29(2), Construction 2.26 and Stacks Tag 0GL6; the K-flat normalization of the scalar mate.

proof.text: Resolve J by a flat-term K-flat complex, apply the scalar/pullback tensor comparison and the mate counit equation, then descend the equality through the derived localization to arbitrary unbounded J.

lean.statement:
theorem scalarMate_restrict_eq_projection_unbounded
    {A B : Type (u + 1)} [CommRing A] [CommRing B] (φ : A →+* B)
    {Z W : Scheme.{u}} (f : Z ⟶ W)
    (J : DerivedCategoryModule A Z) :
    (Sheaf.derivedRestrictScalars W.smallEtaleTopology φ).map
        ((scalarMate φ f).app J) ≫
        (scalarRestrictionDirectImageMap φ f).app ((scalarExtension φ Z).obj J) =
      (scalarTensorIso φ W).hom.app (R(lowerStar (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) f).obj J) ≫
        ((rightDerivedLowerStarProjectionMap (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) f).app J).app
          (scalarCoefficient φ W) ≫
        R(lowerStar (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) f).map
          (((derivedTensor (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) Z).obj J).map
              (scalarCoefficientPullbackIso φ f).hom ≫
            (scalarTensorIso φ Z).inv.app J)
